verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a design SaaS with cloud Workspaces, so the axis applies. The pack documents no retention policies, deletion controls or data-purge capabilities. The only nearby evidence is a pricing line item for 'Project archiving' and a local-only MCP server, and both are adjacent features rather than retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
